parsed.post: Discarding the last run (1.0528 vs 1.0358). Increasing the learning rate with Depth 8 likely caused instability. Returning to my best (9b5e464). Since 0.06 was better than 0.12 and 0.10, I'll try a slightly more conservative approach by adding a small WARMUP_RATIO to stabilize the higher capacity model.
parsed.description: Adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to the previous best (Depth 8, LR 0.06) to stabilize training for the high-capacity model.
